lessons.title: Practice Array Reversal
lessons.description: Implement reverse(int[] numbers) so it reverses the array in place — swap elements from both ends while the left index stays below the right index. The test expects {1, 2, 3, 4} to become {4, 3, 2, 1}.
learning_objectives: This step prints the value that moved to the front, using items and 4.

tests.name: test_reverse
tests.test_code: int[] arr = {1, 2, 3, 4}; Solution.reverse(arr); if (arr[0] != 4 || arr[3] != 1) throw new AssertionError("Expected reversed array");
